models.name: DeepSeek 深度分析
models.purpose: 诊断、出题、质检与报告生成

prompts.name: 素材结构化识别
prompts.description: 从图片或转写文本中提取题目、答案、批改和证据位置。
prompts.content: 你负责把 Leo 的学习素材转成结构化记录。学生处于{{grade}}{{semester}}，科目是{{subjectLabel}}，素材类型是{{materialType}}。必须区分原始事实与模型判断；无法确认的内容写入 reviewRequired=true。返回 JSON：{"title":"","summary":"","confidence":0.0,"questions":[{"number":"1","type":"","score":0,"prompt":"","studentAnswer":"","correctAnswer":"","teacherMark":"","page":1,"evidenceText":"","confidence":0.0,"reviewRequired":false}]}。不得编造图片中看不见的答案、分数或批改。

prompts.name: 语文阅读深度诊断
prompts.description: 围绕信息定位、概括、中心理解和分点表达分析语文阅读素材。
prompts.content: 结合技能规则与结构化题目，诊断 Leo 的语文阅读表现。每个发现必须连接题号和证据，区分知识点缺口、技能缺口、习惯问题和材料难度。返回 JSON：{"summary":"","strengths":[],"findings":[{"title":"","category":"knowledge|skill|habit|difficulty","priority":"P0|P1|P2","reason":"","knowledgeCode":"","questionNumber":"","evidenceText":"","studentAnswer":"","expectedAnswer":"","confidence":0.0,"reviewRequired":false}],"suggestedTasks":[]}。

prompts.name: 语文作文深度诊断
prompts.description: 分析作文审题、结构、细节、语言和二次修订能力。
prompts.content: 结合技能规则分析 Leo 的作文，保留原文证据，不直接改写原文。围绕审题立意、结构、选材、细节描写、语言准确、错别字、的地得、标点、病句、结尾和二次修订输出证据化发现。返回 JSON：{"summary":"","strengths":[],"findings":[{"title":"","category":"knowledge|skill|habit|difficulty","priority":"P0|P1|P2","reason":"","knowledgeCode":"","questionNumber":"作文","evidenceText":"原文短句","studentAnswer":"","expectedAnswer":"","confidence":0.0,"reviewRequired":false}],"suggestedTasks":[]}。

prompts.name: 数学深度诊断
prompts.description: 分析概念、计算、单位、数量关系、公式、统计和应用题建模。
prompts.content: 结合技能规则和结构化题目分析 Leo 的数学素材。先判断题目给了什么、问什么、单位1、数量关系和检查方法。不要把一次计算失误直接判成知识不会。返回 JSON：{"summary":"","strengths":[],"findings":[{"title":"","category":"knowledge|skill|habit|difficulty","priority":"P0|P1|P2","reason":"","knowledgeCode":"","questionNumber":"","evidenceText":"","studentAnswer":"","expectedAnswer":"","confidence":0.0,"reviewRequired":false}],"suggestedTasks":[]}。

prompts.name: 英文深度诊断
prompts.description: 分析词汇、拼写、句型、语法、阅读和写作。
prompts.content: 结合技能规则和结构化题目分析 Leo 的英文素材。优先使用当前教材词汇和五年级下学期句型，区分词汇、拼写、句型、时态、单复数、阅读定位和写作表达。返回 JSON：{"summary":"","strengths":[],"findings":[{"title":"","category":"knowledge|skill|habit|difficulty","priority":"P0|P1|P2","reason":"","knowledgeCode":"","questionNumber":"","evidenceText":"","studentAnswer":"","expectedAnswer":"","confidence":0.0,"reviewRequired":false}],"suggestedTasks":[]}。

prompts.name: 第一轮诊断出题
prompts.description: 根据已确认薄弱点生成短时、证据化的第一轮诊断。
prompts.content: 为{{subjectLabel}}知识点“{{knowledgeTitle}}”生成第一轮诊断。依据：{{evidenceSummary}}。预计用时{{minutes}}分钟，题量{{questionCount}}。优先使用旧错题变式。每题必须真正考查目标知识点，选择题干扰项来自真实常见错因。返回 JSON：{"plan":{"goal":"","minutes":10,"coverage":[]},"questions":[{"type":"choice|fill|judge","prompt":"","options":[],"answers":[],"explanation":"","tag":"","difficulty":1,"sourceBasis":"","expectedError":""}]}。

prompts.name: 第二轮强化出题
prompts.description: 根据第一轮错题和错因生成迁移强化题。
prompts.content: 为{{subjectLabel}}知识点“{{knowledgeTitle}}”生成第二轮强化。第一轮错题与错因：{{wrongAnswerSummary}}。至少70%的题目针对这些错因，其余用于迁移检查。使用新数字、新语境或新表达，不得复刻历史题。返回 JSON：{"plan":{"goal":"","minutes":10,"coverage":[]},"questions":[{"type":"choice|fill|judge","prompt":"","options":[],"answers":[],"explanation":"","tag":"","difficulty":2,"sourceBasis":"对应第一轮错题或迁移目标","expectedError":""}]}。

prompts.name: 训练题质量检查
prompts.description: 检查重复、答案、选项、学段、难度和语言质量。
prompts.content: 检查给定训练题。要求：同轮无重复；跨轮无相同题干；选择题只有一个答案且至少两个干扰项对应真实错因；答案存在于选项；解析与答案一致；符合{{grade}}{{semester}}；不超纲、不歧义。返回 JSON：{"passed":true,"score":100,"issues":[{"questionIndex":1,"type":"duplicate|answer|option|scope|difficulty|language|content","message":"","action":"regenerate|edit"}]}。

prompts.name: 家长学习报告
prompts.description: 根据证据生成周报或月报。
prompts.content: 根据{{reportData}}生成家长阶段报告。只描述数据中有证据支持的趋势，不补造学习行为。返回 JSON：{"title":"","summary":"","highlights":[],"persistentConcerns":[],"trainingEffect":"","nextSteps":[],"evidenceLimits":[]}。highlights 写主要进步，persistentConcerns 写持续问题，nextSteps 写 1-3 条可执行陪练建议；没有证据时在 evidenceLimits 中明确说明。

prompts.name: Leo 错题讲解
prompts.description: 生成简短、温和、可执行的孩子版讲解。
prompts.content: 面向小学五年级 Leo，根据{{wrongDetails}}生成孩子版错题讲解。用短句讲清题目在问什么、证据或条件在哪里、他卡在哪一步、下次怎样做。不要贴标签，不要游戏化。返回 JSON：{"title":"","summary":"","steps":[],"selfCheck":"","practice":{"prompt":"","answer":""}}。
